domain: The Reasoning Ladder Lineage — R0-R12 capability tiers, Icarus, Erebos, and reasoning-evaluation doctrine
one_line: Three generations of "make reasoning measurable" culminated in the program's one calibrated non-gameable instrument (Harmonia's testable ladder + verifier lens + grading oracle) — but three incompatible tier vocabularies still coexist, the decisive experiments (model zoo, R12 live, dissociation replication) were built and never run, and every consumer of the instrument is dead or aspirational.
purpose_and_thesis: Replace "did the model get the answer?" with tiered, falsification-first capability measurement. Doctrine #1 (pivot/reasoning_ladder_v01_2026-05-24.md): a system occupies tier R_k only if the mechanism survives perturbation, beats lower-tier baselines, and fails in tier-predicted ways. Doctrine #2: capability is read from the SHAPE of failure, not the pass/fail binary — the failure signature is the deliverable. Operationalization (harmonia/memory/architecture/reasoning_ladder_testable.md, James's design 2026-05-27): capability = operation + perturbation + failure_mode + evidence_artifact, 4 probe versions (clean/isomorphic/adversarial/transfer), deterministic non-LLM grading. Icarus is the experimental subject (can a self-improving loop climb an externally-authored ladder without Goodharting its evaluator?); Erebos is the generator-side application (no claim emitted without a declared tier + falsification route); the ladder itself became the program's progress meter under the June "Prometheus = TDD layer" reframing.

strategic_read: This domain quietly produced the program's two most valuable things and then failed to use either. First: the measurement instrument. Harmonia's testable ladder + verifier lens + grading oracle is the only calibrated, non-gameable, deterministic capability meter Prometheus owns, and under the June 'Prometheus = TDD layer' identity it IS the product — yet it grades nothing (zero consumers), covers only 7 of 13 rungs, and is saturated below R7 for exactly the models that matter. Second: the finding. Three independent walls (Icarus R2, R3, R5) fell not to capability improvements but to making failure emit direction — and M0 found the same shape at instrument level (novel truths unrepresentable, not undecidable). 'The stall is representational/interface, not epistemic' is this lineage's discovery; the program's diagnosis-of-record traces here. What the domain needs is not new theory but execution of its own backlog, in cost order: (1) run the model zoo (~1.2k calls) — it settles ladder-vs-basis, the open question every tier claim rests on; (2) run R12 live — the one upper-tier grader all four frontier reviewers endorsed, and the most Prometheus-native probe of the north-star behavior; (3) wire grading_oracle to one real consumer (Hephaestus composed engine is a one-import job per its own docs) so 'progress meter' stops being aspirational; (4) declare ONE canonical tier vocabulary — the testable ladder, since it's the only one with an implementation — and force-remap Hephaestus's CATEGORY_TIER and retire ladder.py's frozen text, because right now cross-subsystem R-numbers are semantically void and the program's headline capability claims (+32pp R4, 83% coverage, R9 falsified) are measured on three different rulers. The Icarus bet, honestly scored: the architecture climbed further than its own designers predicted post-review (R5 fell without the rebuild), stopped mid-experiment for infrastructure reasons, and its kill criterion (200 R5 cycles / 0 capability promotions → retire) was never reached — it is unfinished, not falsified, and its typed-residue instrumentation is the best failure-representation machinery in the program.
